description: This Lua script tests the generational garbage collection implementation in Lua, including marking, barriers, finalizers, weak tables, and userdata behavior.

methods.name: gcage
methods.description: Returns the garbage collection age classification ('new', 'survival', 'old', etc.) for a given object or table.

methods.name: gccolor
methods.description: Returns the garbage collector's color state ('gray', 'black', etc.) for garbage collection objects, used internally.
